source.title: Rubik's Cube European Championships 2014 on August 8-10, 2014 in Roskilde, Denmark
source.content: The [Rubik's Cube European Championships 2014](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2014) will take place on August 8-10, 2014 in Roskilde, Denmark. Check out the [Rubik's Cube European Championships 2014 website](http://competition.odderen.dk/Euro2014) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2014 年欧洲魔方锦标赛将于 8 月 8–10 日在丹麦罗斯基勒举行
translation.content: [2014 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2014)将于 2014 年 8 月 8–10 日在丹麦罗斯基勒举行。详情及报名请查看[赛事官网](http://competition.odderen.dk/Euro2014)。
